result.summary: The intersection is equipped with essential pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalized crossings. However, the effectiveness of these features is compromised by faded pavement markings and parked vehicles that obstruct sightlines at the corners.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the right side may block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, near the church

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility patterns to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the intersection.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with mixed-use land use, including a church and commercial storefronts. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being controlled by a traffic light.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the intersection block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and uneven, which can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians crossing outside of a marked area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style painted crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

result.summary: The image depicts a two-lane urban street with mixed-use development and a faded crosswalk. Pedestrian safety is limited by degraded pavement markings and significant visual obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing point.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Surface
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt can create tripping hazards or uneven surfaces for pedestrians crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, safety is compromised by a vehicle parked directly at the crosswalk, which severely obstructs sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Daylighting Obstruction
hazards.description: A silver SUV is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking the view of pedestrians (particularly children) for approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, at the edge of the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to physically prevent parking at the corner, improve pedestrian visibility, and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting with Flex Posts
interventions.description: Implement daylighting by removing parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk and installing flexible delineator posts to maintain clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow vehicle speeds and increase the prominence of the pedestrian crossing area.
